Overview

San Angelo is a city in TX with a population of 100,000. Concho Valley hub with Goodfellow Air Force Base and the San Angelo Museum of Fine Arts. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 8a growing zone supports Warm — citrus, avocados, tomatoes, peppers. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 250 sunny days a year.
